name: ui-ux
summary: The pack had eleven commands and every one of them handed a decision back. /design-first asks which path, /enhance-ui offers three variants, /redesign gates on approval, /ui-sweep stops between phases — each gate correct, each there because a human wanted to steer, and collectively there was no way to say 'go through every page and finish it, do not ask me'. /ui-audit is that run: the visual sibling of the top-level /audit, sharing its shape exactly — matrix scan, cross-axis rank, cell ledger, tiered execution, verify — over routes and axes instead of surfaces and concerns. It adds no detector and no verb: it drives /ui-crawl for browser truth, /ui-sweep's 8 detectors, redesign.md's language-or-composition test, creative-director's 9-lens Direction rubric, ui-design-sweep's closed 19 verbs and /redesign's composition rebuild. What is new is the autonomy contract, which names the mechanism resolving each gate rather than removing it: $SOURCE is always system because a project-wide sweep is bound to the project's language by definition; the variant pick becomes the rubric's highest score with ties breaking toward the existing language; /redesign's approval becomes one revertable commit per surface, so the gate is a diff read afterwards instead of a prompt answered beforehand. Against that, five HALTs and only five — a blocked render, no token source, a dirty tree or red CI, a fix that re-detects after being applied, and --reimagine on a multi-theme app. The first is the one the design exists for: a route behind a login wall gets its own ledger column and stops the run, because an unrendered route scored as clean is the failure every autonomous visual sweep dies of. Two further gaps closed with it. The boundary with /audit is now written down as a seam rather than assumed, splitting by EVIDENCE and not by topic — accessibility, UX and the render half of i18n/RTL come here because a contrast ratio and a focus order are rendered properties, while frontend code quality, render waste and web-vitals stay with /audit because their proof is a profile; a finding neither can verify becomes a named Live-unreviewed cell instead of falling between two commands that each assumed the other had it. And verb 12 lift-contrast gained the floating-surface fingerprint: every contrast check in the closed set measured something AGAINST a surface and nothing measured the surface against what it sits on, so a #ffffff card on a #f8fafc page — 1.04:1 — passed every text check, every axe rule and every token audit with its edges invisible. Measured from the render, fixed at the role with the project's existing elevation language, verified in dark mode too, where a shadow tuned on a light page routinely vanishes.
